newsitem.title: PERU: Buenaventura to decide on dividend Nov 29.
newsitem.headline: Buenaventura to decide on dividend Nov 29.

text.p: Shareholders of Peruvian mining company Buenaventura will decide at a November 29 meeting on whether the company will pay a cash dividend of 0.08 soles on its Series A shares, the Lima bolsa said Monday.
The exchange's daily report said shareholders would also consider Buenaventura's absorption of two other Peruvian mining companies, Compania Orcopampa SA and Compania de Minas Recuperadas SA.
Buenaventura has also decided to cancel a $25 million bond issue approved in May 1995.
Buenaventura Series A and B shares, and its labor shares, are traded in Lima, and its American depositary shares are traded in New York.
